method: Commit authors per Scala minor version, from bare blob-less clones of github.com/scala/scala (2.5-2.13) and github.com/scala/scala3 (3.0-3.9, formerly lampepfl/dotty), cloned 2026-09-28. Each version counts `git log --no-merges --use-mailmap` over <previous minor's first release tag>..<this minor's first release tag> (e.g. v2.12.0..v2.13.0); 2.5 starts at v2.4.0; 3.0 is the whole scala3 history up to 3.0.0. Deviations: 2.7 has no v2.7.0 tag, so its end (and 2.8's start) is trunk commit bee89ecede8f, the last one on or before the 2.7.0 release date 2008-03-06; 3.6 uses 3.6.2 (the official first 3.6 release; 3.6.0 was an accidental publish and has no tag); 3.8 excludes the 6011 imported Scala 2 stdlib commits (^7a75a09b13ae). Pre-2.11 tags sit on release branches, so a range is 'reachable from the new tag but not from the old one'. Authors are the repo .mailmap names (%aN), then merged into one identity when they share an email address, a GitHub noreply login, or the same name up to case, accents, punctuation and word order; merges are listed under 'merges'. Commits by dependabot[bot], github-actions[bot] and the AI agent 'Claude' (noreply@anthropic.com) are excluded and listed under 'excluded', as are the 37 SVN-era commits (2.7, 2.8) whose author was recorded as a placeholder (e.g. 'NAME <USER@epfl.ch>'), which the scala/scala .mailmap maps to 'Unknown Committer'. Counts are by author (not committer), one per commit, with no weighting by size.

versions.notes: v2.4.0 and v2.5.0 are SVN release tags on release branches, not ancestors of each other; the range is the commits reachable from v2.5.0 but not from v2.4.0 (trunk work after the 2.4 branch point, plus the 2.5 release branch). The same holds for 2.5-2.10.
Tags are on SVN release branches (see 2.5).

There is no v2.7.0 tag in scala/scala (the first 2.7 tag is v2.7.1). Used the last trunk commit on or before the official 2.7.0 release date (2008-03-06): bee89ecede8f (Iulian Dragos, 2008-03-06 21:45 UTC, 'Switched to scala.StringBuilder'). Using v2.7.1 instead would give v2.6.0..v2.7.1 = 937 commits. Excluded: Unknown Committer 7.
Starts at the same 2.7.0 stand-in commit bee89ecede8f (no v2.7.0 tag). Includes the long 2.8 development cycle (2008-2010, collections redesign). Excluded: Unknown Committer 30.
Tags are on SVN/git release branches (see 2.5).
v2.9.0 is on a release branch; range is commits reachable from v2.10.0 not from v2.9.0.

Whole history of scala/scala3 (formerly lampepfl/dotty) up to tag 3.0.0: all of Dotty's development since the first commit on 2012-12-06, so it covers ~8.5 years, not one release cycle. Alternative (author date after the 2.13.0 release, 2019-06-07, up to 3.0.0) is given in 'since_2_13' below. Also includes the scaladoc (scala3doc) project, merged into the repo in 2020 with its own history.

There is no 3.6.0 tag: 3.6.0 was published to Maven Central by accident during the 3.6.0-RC1 release (Oct 2024) and 3.6.1 was a hotfix to supersede it; the Scala team says 3.6.2 (2024-12-10) is to be regarded as 3.6.0. Used 3.6.2. (3.5.0..3.6.1 would give 645 commits.) 3.7 starts from 3.6.2 accordingly. Excluded: dependabot[bot] 11.

Excludes the Scala 2 standard library history (6011 non-merge commits from scala/scala, 2005-2025, e.g. Paul Phillips, Martin Odersky) that PR #23522 (merge 13fd5af95d42, 2025-07-15, '[stdlib] embed the history of the scala 2 stdlib into dotty's history') grafted into scala3; range is 3.7.0..3.8.0 ^7a75a09b13ae (the imported branch head). Without the exclusion the count would be 7636. Excluded: dependabot[bot] 9.
Tag 3.9.0 exists (commit dated 2026-08-26). Excluded: dependabot[bot] 26, Claude 19.
